extracted.rawText:
Maya Salazar
maya.salazar@example.com | Tampa, FL
Maya Salazar has 16 years of experience in backend and distributed systems.
Most recently, Principal Backend Engineer at Vertex Platform (2022-2026), where
they led migration of core services at Vertex Platform onto AWS, improving
uptime during peak load. Before that, Staff Backend Engineer at Northbeam
Analytics (2020-2022). Before that, Senior Backend Engineer at Redbank Networks
(2010-2020). Education: Ph.D. Computer Science, Penn State University, 2010;
B.S. Computer Science, Portland State University, 2005. Core skills:
PostgreSQL, Kafka, Redis, TypeScript, CI/CD, Distributed systems, REST API
design, Java, AWS, Node.js.
